title: Extend a tensor comparison from two K-flat factors to one
statement: Let C be a small ringed site with coefficient ring sheaf R and independent module universes [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Fix its unbounded derived localization Q [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], its closed structure S [lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal] and simultaneous K-flat total-tensor comparison T [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. There is a family of isomorphisms Q Tot(P tensor N) ≅ S.tensor(QP, QN) whenever P or N is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex]. It is natural for chain maps between such pairs and agrees with the specified T comparison when both factors are K-flat. Naturality is an equality of the actual comparison morphisms, including when only one factor on each side is K-flat.

source.place: Tags 06YS (functorial K-flat resolution), 06YT (one K-flat tensor computes derived tensor), and 0FPT.

proof.text: Take the reduced functorial flat resolution F with augmentation eta. Each F(P) is K-flat; the acyclic-tensor formulation follows by tensoring the quasi-isomorphism 0 to an acyclic test complex. The two augmentation tensor map is a quasi-isomorphism when either target factor is K-flat, by factoring through two tensor maps whose unchanged factor is K-flat. The native K-flat comparison identifies the acyclic-tensor predicate with preservation of quasi-isomorphisms by tensoring; independently sized tensor colimits supply the colimit hypotheses for the reduced resolution construction.

Define t by the inverse localized tensor augmentation, then the prescribed comparison on F(P),F(N), then derived tensor of the augmentations. The naturality square of eta, functoriality of total tensor, and naturality of T give naturality of t. If both P,N are K-flat, naturality of T on their augmentations cancels the inverse localized augmentation and identifies t with T.

proof_origin.place: Tags 06YS, 06YT and 0FPT; functorial resolution construction fully proved in Lean.
